name: 地域別最低賃金 (regional minimum wage, hourly)

rules.authority: 最低賃金法 arts.9–14: each prefecture's 地域別最低賃金 (hourly, yen) with the day its order took effect, newest first: the 令和6年度 amount where it still governed on 1 December 2025, the 令和7年度 amount and the decided 令和8年度 amount (in force from its own day; 最低賃金法 art.14(2)). A line reads the amount in force on the last day of the pay period, which pays the higher amount for a whole month in which it took effect. name: 健康保険・厚生年金保険料の納付 (social insurance premium payment)

rules.authority: 雇用保険法施行規則 art.141(1): "その設置…の日の翌日から起算して十日以内". A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2); the year-end closure (29 December–3 January) moves it only when the entity publishes those days.

name: 給与支払事務所等の開設届出書 (payroll office opening notification)

rules.description: Notify the tax office that a payroll office was opened.
rules.authority: 所得税法 art.230: "その事実があつた日から一月以内". A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2); the year-end closure (29 December–3 January) moves it only when the entity publishes those days.

name: 時間外労働の限度時間 45時間 (monthly overtime limit)

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && work.overtime_hours - sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST").map(d, d.overtime_hours)) > 45.0
rules.message: Overtime above 45 hours this month: lawful only under the special clause of the 36 agreement, and in at most six months a year (労働基準法 art.36(4)–(5)).
rules.description: Statutory overtime other than rest-day work beyond the 45-hour monthly limit.
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(3)–(5): the limit is 45 hours a month and 360 hours a year; a special clause may exceed 45 hours in at most six months a year (働き方改革関連法, in force for all employers since April 2020). The yearly 360/720-hour totals and the 2–6 month 80-hour average need hours of earlier months, which no root carries.

name: 時間外・休日労働 100時間未満 (absolute monthly cap)

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (work.overtime_hours - sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST").map(d, d.overtime_hours))) + sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST").map(d, d.worked_hours)) >= 100.0
rules.message: Overtime and statutory rest-day work reached 100 hours this month; the law requires under 100 even under a special clause (労働基準法 art.36(6)(ii)).
rules.description: The absolute cap on overtime plus rest-day work in one month.
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(ii): overtime and rest-day work together must be under 100 hours in each month; art.119 (penalty). The wages are still owed, so the slip warns rather than refuses.

name: 最低賃金を下回る労働契約 (contract below the regional minimum wage)

rules.when: terms.work_classification != "OFFICER" && has(company.facts.monthly_average_scheduled_hours) && company.region in rules.minimum_wage.by_region && terms.base_salary > 0.0 && terms.base_salary / double(company.facts.monthly_average_scheduled_hours) < double(rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region][size(rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region]) - 1].amount)
rules.message: The base salary is below the prefecture's regional minimum wage per scheduled hour; such a term is void (最低賃金法 art.4(2)).
rules.description: A term whose hourly base is below the lowest regional minimum wage the lineage carries for the prefecture.
rules.authority: 最低賃金法 art.4(1)–(2) with 施行規則 art.2: a contract wage below the minimum is void to that extent. The check compares with the lowest amount the lineage lists for the region (the term's own day is not in the contract context); the payslip top-up (MINIMUM_WAGE_TOP_UP) pays the amount in force on the period.

name: 賞与支払届 (bonus payment report)

rules.description: Report the bonus paid to an insured person, for the standard bonus amount.
rules.authority: 健康保険法 art.48 with 施行規則 art.27 and 厚生年金保険法 art.27 with 施行規則 art.19の5: "賞与を支払った日から五日以内" — raised when a payslip carrying a BONUS line is paid (row.line_codes, row.paid_on); the due day counts the payment day (the earliest reading). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.when: has(row.line_codes) && "BONUS" in row.line_codes && has(row.paid_on) && row.paid_on != null
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= row.paid_on && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= row.paid_on) && has(t.statutory_work_category) && t.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "SOCIAL_ONLY"])

name: 産前産後休業取得者申出書 (maternity premium exemption application)

rules.description: Apply to the pension office for the health and pension premium exemption during prenatal and postnatal leave (and the change notice when the leave ends early or late).
rules.authority: 健康保険法 art.159の3 and 厚生年金保険法 art.81の2の2 with 健康保険法施行規則 art.135の2: the employer applies while the leave lasts (the leave's last day is the due day shown; 日本年金機構 guidance). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.when: has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code in ["PRENATAL_LEAVE", "POSTNATAL_LEAVE"]
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= row.from && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= row.from) && has(t.statutory_work_category) && t.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "SOCIAL_ONLY"])
rules.due: next_working_day((has(row.to) && row.to != null ? row.to : row.from), holidays)

name: 育児休業等取得者申出書 (childcare premium exemption application)

rules.description: Apply to the pension office for the health and pension premium exemption during childcare leave (including 産後パパ育休).
rules.authority: 健康保険法 art.159 and 厚生年金保険法 art.81の2 with 健康保険法施行規則 art.135: the employer applies while the leave lasts (the leave's last day is the due day shown). A month is exempt when the leave includes its last day, or lasts 14 days or more within it; a bonus month only for a leave of more than one month. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.when: has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code in ["CHILDCARE_LEAVE", "POSTNATAL_PATERNITY_LEAVE"]
rules.applies_when: contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= row.from && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= row.from) && has(t.statutory_work_category) && t.statutory_work_category in ["SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT", "SOCIAL_ONLY"])
rules.due: next_working_day((has(row.to) && row.to != null ? row.to : row.from), holidays)

name: 労働者死傷病報告 (work-injury report, 4 days or more)

rules.description: Report the occupational injury to the labour standards office electronically, without delay, once the absence reaches 4 days.
rules.authority: 労働安全衛生法 art.100 with 労働安全衛生規則 art.97(1): "遅滞なく" for a death or an absence of 4 days or more (electronic filing from 1 January 2025); the 4th day of absence is the due day shown. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.when: has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code == "OCCUPATIONAL_INJURY_ABSENCE" && has(row.days) && row.days != null && row.days >= 4.0

name: 労働者死傷病報告 (work-injury report, under 4 days)

rules.description: Report an occupational injury absence of 1 to 3 days in the quarterly report.
rules.authority: 労働安全衛生規則 art.97(2): absences under 4 days of January–March, April–June, July–September and October–December by the end of the month after each quarter. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).
rules.when: has(row.catalog_code) && row.catalog_code == "OCCUPATIONAL_INJURY_ABSENCE" && (!has(row.days) || row.days == null || row.days < 4.0)

name: 女性の活躍に関する情報公表 (women's advancement information publication)

rules.description: Publish the gender wage gap, the female manager ratio and the other required items for the business year just ended.
rules.authority: 女性の職業生活における活躍の推進に関する法律 art.20 (as amended, from 1 April 2026: the gender wage gap and the female manager ratio for an employer of 101 or more, previously the wage gap for 301 or more) with 一般事業主行動計画等に関する省令 art.19(4) ("おおむね一年に一回以上"); the ministry's notice places it within about three months of the business-year end. Headcount is the entity's employments in force; the business-year end month is company.facts.business_year_end_month. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

name: 年次有給休暇の時季指定 (5-day designated annual leave)

rules.description: On each grant day of 10 or more days, ensure the worker takes at least 5 of them by the end of that grant year, designating the days after hearing the worker; record them in the 年次有給休暇管理簿.
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.39(7)–(8) with 施行規則 arts.24の5–24の7; art.120 (penalty). Raised on each grant day — 6 months after hire and every year after (the 六箇月経過日 and its anniversaries) — except for a short-week worker granted fewer than 10 days (施行規則 art.24の3).
rules.when: hired_on != null && calendar_completed_months(hired_on, today) >= 6 && today == add_months(hired_on, 6.0 + 12.0 * double(int((calendar_completed_months(hired_on, today) - 6.0) / 12.0)))
rules.applies_when: !(contract != null && has(contract.facts) && has(contract.facts.contract_terms) && contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(t, t.effective_range["from"] <= today && (!has(t.effective_range.to) || t.effective_range.to == null || t.effective_range.to >= today) && has(t.facts) && has(t.facts.weekly_scheduled_days) && double(t.facts.weekly_scheduled_days) <= 4.0 && (!has(t.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) || double(t.facts.weekly_scheduled_hours) < 30.0) && !(double(t.facts.weekly_scheduled_days) >= 4.0 && calendar_completed_months(hired_on, today) >= 42)))

name: 時間外労働の限度時間 年360時間 (yearly overtime limit)

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (has(hours.year) ? hours.year.overtime_hours - (has(hours.year.day_type) && has(hours.year.day_type.REST) ? hours.year.day_type.REST.overtime_hours : 0.0) : 0.0) > 360.0
rules.message: Overtime this calendar year is above 360 hours: lawful only under the special clause of the 36 agreement (労働基準法 art.36(4)–(5)).
rules.description: Statutory overtime other than rest-day work beyond 360 hours from 1 January (hours.year).
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(4): the limit is 360 hours a year (320 for a one-year variable schedule, not modelled). The year is the calendar year of hours.year; an agreement whose year starts on another day (company.facts.overtime_agreement_from) is counted from 1 January.

name: 特別条項の上限 年720時間 (yearly cap under a special clause)

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (has(hours.year) ? hours.year.overtime_hours - (has(hours.year.day_type) && has(hours.year.day_type.REST) ? hours.year.day_type.REST.overtime_hours : 0.0) : 0.0) > 720.0
rules.message: Overtime this calendar year is above 720 hours, the absolute yearly cap even under a special clause (労働基準法 art.36(5)).
rules.description: Statutory overtime other than rest-day work beyond 720 hours from 1 January.
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(5): under a special clause, overtime (rest-day work excluded) at most 720 hours a year; art.119 (penalty).

name: 複数月平均80時間以内 (2- and 3-month average cap)

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && (((has(hours.month) ? hours.month.overtime_hours - (has(hours.month.day_type) && has(hours.month.day_type.REST) ? hours.month.day_type.REST.overtime_hours : 0.0) : 0.0) + (has(hours.month) ? (has(hours.month.day_type) && has(hours.month.day_type.REST) ? hours.month.day_type.REST.worked_hours : 0.0) : 0.0) + (has(hours.previous_month) ? hours.previous_month.overtime_hours - (has(hours.previous_month.day_type) && has(hours.previous_month.day_type.REST) ? hours.previous_month.day_type.REST.overtime_hours : 0.0) : 0.0) + (has(hours.previous_month) ? (has(hours.previous_month.day_type) && has(hours.previous_month.day_type.REST) ? hours.previous_month.day_type.REST.worked_hours : 0.0) : 0.0)) / 2.0 > 80.0 || ((has(hours.rolling) ? hours.rolling.overtime_hours - (has(hours.rolling.day_type) && has(hours.rolling.day_type.REST) ? hours.rolling.day_type.REST.overtime_hours : 0.0) : 0.0) + (has(hours.rolling) ? (has(hours.rolling.day_type) && has(hours.rolling.day_type.REST) ? hours.rolling.day_type.REST.worked_hours : 0.0) : 0.0)) / 3.0 > 80.0)
rules.message: Overtime and rest-day work average more than 80 hours a month over the last two or three months (労働基準法 art.36(6)(iii)).
rules.description: The 2- and 3-month averages of overtime plus rest-day work (hours.month, hours.previous_month, hours.rolling).
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(iii): overtime and rest-day work averaged over every 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 month span at most 80 hours a month. The 4- to 6-month spans need hours beyond hours.rolling and are not checked.

name: 36協定の有効期間外の時間外労働 (overtime outside the 36 agreement)

rules.when: !(terms.work_classification in ["MANAGERIAL", "OFFICER"]) && work.overtime_hours > 0.0 && has(company.facts.overtime_agreement_to) && (period.to > company.facts.overtime_agreement_to || (has(company.facts.overtime_agreement_from) && period.from < company.facts.overtime_agreement_from))
rules.message: Overtime falls outside the period of the 36 agreement on record (company.facts overtime_agreement_from/to); overtime needs an agreement filed with the labour standards office (労働基準法 arts.32, 36(1)).
rules.description: Overtime in a period the recorded agreement does not cover.
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(1): overtime and rest-day work are lawful only under a written agreement filed with the labour standards office; customer input: company.facts.overtime_agreement_from, overtime_agreement_to.

name: 36協定の締結・届出 (overtime agreement renewal and filing)

rules.description: Conclude the next overtime and rest-day work agreement and file it with the labour standards office before the current one expires.
rules.authority: 労働基準法 art.36(1) with 施行規則 art.16–17: the agreement takes effect only once filed; its period is at most one year in practice (the yearly limit is set per year). Customer input: company.facts.overtime_agreement_to. Raised in the run of the month before the expiry month.

name: 労働保険料 延納 第2期 (labour insurance instalment 2)

rules.description: Pay the labour insurance premium instalment due 31 October.
rules.authority: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 art.18 with 施行規則 arts.27–28: an employer whose provisional premium is 400,000 or more (or entrusted to a labour insurance association) may pay in three instalments — 10 July, 31 October and 31 January; customer input: company.facts.labour_insurance_instalments. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2) applied by 徴収法 art.41).

name: 労働保険料 延納 第3期 (labour insurance instalment 3)

rules.description: Pay the labour insurance premium instalment due 31 January.
rules.authority: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 art.18 with 施行規則 arts.27–28: an employer whose provisional premium is 400,000 or more (or entrusted to a labour insurance association) may pay in three instalments — 10 July, 31 October and 31 January; customer input: company.facts.labour_insurance_instalments. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2) applied by 徴収法 art.41).
